title: Delegate or Automate
summary: Matrix for keeping, delegating, or automating tasks — use AI for repetitive low-risk tasks; rely on humans for judgment.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction to the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? Not every task needs to stay with you — repetitive tasks can be delegated or automated, and AI can classify, summarize, and draft.
- Why now? After assessing operational readiness, the next step is to decide what can be handed off.
- What after the lesson? You will list 5 weekly tasks and categorize them: Keep, Delegate, Automate with AI, or AI + Human Review.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- A business owner writes every response, checks every invoice, reviews every post — then wonders why there’s no time to expand.
- Not every task deserves your time. Strategic decisions and sensitive relationships — those are yours. Repetitive tasks — for the system, team, or AI.
- AI can: summarize, classify, draft, and suggest order. High-level judgment and final approval — that’s for a human.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Matrix: Keep — Delegate — Automate
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Keep: Rare decisions, high trust, sensitive relationships — do not hand them over to AI without review.
- Delegate: Clear tasks for a human — daily follow-up, field execution, direct customer service.
- Automate with AI: Repetitive + data + low risk — summarizing, templating, sorting messages.
- AI + Human Review: AI drafts the message, you approve before sending — suitable for pricing and complaints.

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.subtitle: Terms for Delegation
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| Delegate | Handing over a clear task to a human who executes it according to your standards | An employee responds to shipping inquiries — using a template you approved |
| Automate with AI | AI performs a repetitive step — with limits and review as needed | Summarizing 20 WhatsApp messages every morning into a priority list |

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Classify 5 Weekly Tasks
sections.contentMarkdown:
Introduction: Write down 5 tasks you do every week (or almost). For each task, specify: Keep / Delegate / Automate with AI / AI + Human Review. No execution is required — only a distribution decision. Submission: The five tasks + the classification for each one · the task you will start with next week — and why. Evaluation Criteria: | Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| Logical Classification | 60% | 5 real tasks — each with a suitable classification for risk and repetition |
| First Step | 40% | One selected task to start with a reason |
